speaker: narrator
text: Part seven. Jay found Bit. And *Mr. Gray*.

speaker: narrator
text: Gray stands between Jay and Bit. *Smiling*.

speaker: boss
text: Two minutes, Jay. Then version two goes *everywhere*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit! Doctor Ada made a patch. It's *right here*!

speaker: bit
text: Jay. The patch can only travel *through me*.

speaker: bit
text: It will erase version two. And everything *around it*.

speaker: hero
text: Everything? You mean *you*.

speaker: boss
text: He won't do it. Nobody deletes their *best friend*.

speaker: bit
text: Jay. I backed myself up once. *Trust me*.

speaker: hero
text: Is that true? Bit, is that *true*?

speaker: bit
text: Eleven fifty nine, Jay. *Plug it in*.

speaker: narrator
text: Gray lunges. Jay is *faster*.

speaker: narrator
text: Click. Twelve o'clock. The tower *fires*.

speaker: narrator
text: A green wave rolls over the whole *city*.

speaker: narrator
text: On every phone, the same words. *Patch installed*.

speaker: narrator
text: Down below, a thousand hands *let go*.

speaker: boss
text: No. No! My *update*!

speaker: narrator
text: Bit's screen flickers. His eyes get *smaller*.

speaker: bit
text: Told you, Jay. *Highly* advanced...

speaker: narrator
text: And the little yellow screen goes *black*.

speaker: narrator
text: The final part drops in two days.
